mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(u.id) AS id, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS displayName, (SELECT LISTAGG(r.role_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.role_code) FROM edudoc_user_role ur JOIN edudoc_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id) AS role, u.account_status AS accountStatus, u.department AS department, CASE WHEN u.last_login_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(u.last_login_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || 'Z' END AS lastLoginTime

WHERE 1 = 1
AND (UPPER(u.username) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(u.display_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '\')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edudoc_user_role ur2 JOIN edudoc_role r2 ON r2.id = ur2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id = u.id AND r2.role_code = #{role})
AND u.account_status = #{status}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM edudoc_user u
ORDER BY u.username OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM edudoc_user u WHERE u.id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_user_role ur JOIN edudoc_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND r.role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_user SET account_status = #{newStatus}, update_time = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND account_status = #{expected}
